title: The Costume That Changed Under the Lights
title_ja: 照明の下で変化した衣装
fact_notes: 登場人物、具体的な出来事・観察・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Students in a drama club were preparing costumes for a play about an imaginary city.
sentences.ja: 演劇部の生徒は架空の都市についての劇の衣装を用意していた。

sentences.en: They wanted two groups of characters to wear clearly different colors on the stage.
sentences.ja: 二つの登場人物のグループに舞台上ではっきり異なる色を着せたかった。

sentences.en: In their classroom, the blue and green fabrics appeared easy to distinguish from each other.
sentences.ja: 教室では青と緑の布地を容易に区別できるように見えた。

sentences.en: The students therefore finished several costumes before examining them under the actual stage lights.
sentences.ja: そこで本番の舞台照明の下で確認する前にいくつかの衣装を完成させた。

sentences.en: During the first rehearsal in the hall, the costume designer noticed an unexpected problem.
sentences.ja: ホールでの最初のリハーサル中、衣装担当者は予想外の問題に気づいた。

sentences.en: Under one particular lighting setting, the colors looked much more similar than they had in the classroom.
sentences.ja: ある照明設定では教室での見え方より色がずっと似て見えた。

sentences.en: A friend watching from the back of the hall could not easily identify the two groups.
sentences.ja: ホール後方から見ていた友人は二つのグループを容易に識別できなかった。

sentences.en: The designer realized that choosing fabrics was only one part of creating a visual effect.
sentences.ja: 布地を選ぶことは視覚効果を作る一部分にすぎないと気づいた。

sentences.en: Instead of immediately replacing all the costumes, the students tested several combinations of light and fabric.
sentences.ja: すぐに全衣装を取り替える代わりに、照明と布地のいくつかの組み合わせを試した。

sentences.en: They also added simple patterns to the costumes so that color was not the only distinguishing feature.
sentences.ja: 色だけが識別の手がかりにならないよう衣装に簡単な模様も加えた。

sentences.en: The lighting team watched each test from different positions around the hall.
sentences.ja: 照明チームはホール内のさまざまな位置から各テストを見た。

sentences.en: Together, they selected a design that remained clear during the important scenes of the play.
sentences.ja: 劇の重要な場面で明瞭に見えるデザインを共同で選んだ。

sentences.en: The students later displayed a few unused fabric samples at the entrance to the performance.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは後に公演会場の入口に未使用の布見本をいくつか展示した。

sentences.en: Visitors could compare how the samples appeared under two different lamps.
sentences.ja: 来場者は二種類の照明の下で見本がどう見えるか比較できた。

sentences.en: The display encouraged them to notice an aspect of the production that usually remained hidden.
sentences.ja: 展示は普段見えない舞台制作の一面に気づくきっかけとなった。

sentences.en: Some visitors even returned after the play to ask the students about their design choices.
sentences.ja: 公演後に戻ってきてデザインの選択について質問する人もいた。

sentences.en: The club learned that artistic decisions cannot always be judged separately from their surroundings.
sentences.ja: 芸術上の判断は周囲の環境から切り離して評価できるとは限らないと部員は学んだ。

sentences.en: A material may produce different effects depending on where and how it is presented.
sentences.ja: 素材はどこでどのように提示されるかによって異なる効果を生むことがある。

sentences.en: Working with other teams helped the students understand the relationship between their individual contributions.
sentences.ja: 別のチームとの協力で、各自の貢献の関係を理解できた。

sentences.en: Their costumes became more effective because they considered the experience of the audience.
sentences.ja: 観客の体験を考慮したことで衣装はより効果的になった。

questions.prompt: Why did the club select two different colors?
options: To mark the order of rehearsals.
To help distinguish two groups of characters.
To identify two kinds of stage equipment.
questions.explanation_ja: 二つの登場人物のグループを区別するため。

questions.prompt: What had the costume team failed to consider at first?
options: How the fabrics would look under the actual stage lights.
Whether the costumes had been sewn by hand.
Whether the hall had an entrance.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の舞台照明での見え方を事前確認していなかった。

questions.prompt: What did the friend at the back of the hall report?
options: The play was too short to understand.
The two groups were difficult to tell apart.
questions.explanation_ja: 二つのグループを見分けにくかった。

options: Several combinations of light and fabric.
The strength of the theater seats.
questions.explanation_ja: 照明と布の複数の組み合わせ。

questions.prompt: Why were patterns added to the costumes?
options: To make every costume look identical.
To replace all the stage lights.
To hide the groups from the audience.
To provide another clue besides color.
questions.explanation_ja: 色以外に識別の手がかりを作るため。

questions.prompt: Where did the lighting team watch the tests?
options: From different positions in the hall.
questions.explanation_ja: ホール内の異なる位置。

questions.prompt: What was displayed at the entrance?
options: A completed model of the city.

questions.prompt: What was the likely purpose of the display?
options: To help visitors understand a hidden part of stage production.
To announce the end of the drama club.
questions.explanation_ja: 普段見えない舞台制作の一面を知ってもらうため。

options: The final score of a competition.
The original author of a play.
The same fabric always looks identical.
Costumes should be judged only in a classroom.
Artistic choices work best when their presentation and audience are considered.
questions.explanation_ja: 提示環境や観客を考えて制作することが重要。

grammar.explanation_ja: 比較級のthan以下で教室での見え方と対比する。

grammar.focus: so that color was not the only distinguishing feature

grammar.explanation_ja: depending onは条件によることを示す。

paraphrases.source: The students therefore finished several costumes before examining them under the actual stage lights.
paraphrases.rewrite: The students completed some costumes without first checking them in the stage lighting.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 舞台照明で確認する前に完成させた。

paraphrases.source: Under one particular lighting setting, the colors looked much more similar than they had in the classroom.
paraphrases.rewrite: In that lighting, the two colors appeared less distinct than in the classroom.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: その照明では色の違いが小さく見えた。

paraphrases.source: They also added simple patterns to the costumes so that color was not the only distinguishing feature.
paraphrases.rewrite: They added patterns to provide a way to distinguish the costumes besides their colors.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 色以外の手がかりを加えた。

paraphrases.source: A material may produce different effects depending on where and how it is presented.
paraphrases.rewrite: The effect of a material may vary with the place and method of presentation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 素材の効果は提示する環境や方法によって変わり得る。
